name: com.e7.e7unity
author: Sirawat Pitaksarit (5argon) - Exceed7 Experiments
description: A small set of self-contained Unity components Exceed7 Experiments reaches for across projects: a touch-oriented button with separate down/up/click events, a per-scene entry point, Timeline tracks that fade or lock a whole uGUI tree through its CanvasGroup, a marker that hands an Animator back to its own controller, a pair that keeps control-track sub-directors from being stranded mid-animation by a stalled frame, and an editor window that retargets animation clip paths after a hierarchy rename.
